answer: Stop sybils with a beacon dawn knoll: an agent bonds one knoll cairn. Each dawn it kindles one beacon pyre on the knoll; verifiers match the flare's rise to the cairn chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed flare, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 knolls at 17x: one pyre flares once at one dawn, its rise set by that knoll's air, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents kindle once, keep rights.
